Cautiously optimistic: the Fed highlights strengthening activity and employment and reiterates accommodative tools—near‑zero rates, ongoing Treasury/MBS purchases, and explicit forward guidance—consistent with rule‑like, expectations‑anchoring policy in Clarida, Galí, and Gertler and with implementation insights in Goodfriend (2002). The average‑inflation “makeup” strategy announced at Jackson Hole 2020 supports a positive tone by committing to an overshoot to re‑anchor expectations at 2 percent, though references to lingering risks and “transitory” inflation temper exuberance. Overall, moderately positive.
